:::{#def-intercept-term}
#### Intercept term

When a [function](functions.qmd#def-function) is written as [terms](algebra-sums.qmd#def-term) added together,
its **intercept term** is the [term](algebra-sums.qmd#def-term) with no factor of the [input](functions.qmd#def-argument).
The intercept (@def-intercept) of the function is the [value](functions.qmd#def-value) of that term at input $0$.

:::
